qualification: Isolated no-decode source build and scoped recipe identity

Decode-enabled isolated builds reject missing dependency source identity explicitly.
limits: This is isolated source/minimal-manifest qualification, not cargo package/publish or full decoder package portability.
Decoder dependency identity export, packaged source resolution and external runtime identity remain unresolved.
Conservative input hashing includes tests/assets; no build/runtime performance claim.
